# CompressTo20KB — Full Reference

## About
CompressTo20KB is a free browser-based image compression tool. All compression happens client-side — files never leave the user's device. Supports JPEG, PNG, WebP, AVIF, HEIC formats.

## Key Features
- Exact KB mode: compress to precisely 20KB, 50KB, 100KB, 200KB, 500KB, 1MB, 2MB, 3MB, 5MB, 10MB
- No upload required — 100% private, files processed in browser
- No watermarks, no signup, no file size limits
- Supports batch/bulk compression with ZIP download
- Platform presets: Shopify, Etsy, Amazon, LinkedIn, Instagram, Discord, Zoom, WhatsApp
- Visa photo tools: USCIS, DS-160, DV Lottery, Schengen, UK, Canada, Australia, Japan, China

## Image Size Requirements by Platform (2026)

| Platform | Recommended Size | Max File Size | Format |
|---|---|---|---|
| LinkedIn profile photo | 400×400px | 8MB (compress to <100KB) | JPEG/PNG |
| LinkedIn banner | 1584×396px | 8MB (compress to <1MB) | JPEG/PNG |
| Instagram post | 1080×1080px | 30MB (compress to <500KB) | JPEG |
| Amazon product main | 1000×1000px min | 10MB (compress to <1MB) | JPEG |
| Shopify product | 2048×2048px | 20MB (compress to <500KB) | JPEG/WebP |
| Etsy listing | 2000×2000px | 1MB | JPEG/PNG |
| eBay listing | 500×500px min | 7MB (compress to <500KB) | JPEG |
| Microsoft Teams meeting | any | compress to <500KB | JPEG |
| Zoom background | 1920×1080px | 5MB (compress to <1MB) | JPEG/PNG |
| Discord | 8MB max | compress to <1MB | JPEG/PNG/WebP |
| WhatsApp | compress to <500KB | — | JPEG |
| WordPress | compress to <200KB | — | JPEG/WebP |

## Visa & Government Photo Requirements (2026)

| Application | Size | File Size | Format |
|---|---|---|---|
| US Passport | 2×2 inches (51×51mm) | under 240KB | JPEG |
| USCIS (green card, N-400, I-485) | 2×2 inches | under 240KB | JPEG |
| DS-160 (US visa) | 2×2 inches | under 240KB | JPEG |
| DV Lottery | 2×2 inches | 200KB–240KB | JPEG |
| Schengen visa | 35×45mm | under 500KB | JPEG |
| UK visa | 35×45mm | under 500KB | JPEG |
| Canada visa | 35×45mm | under 4MB | JPEG |
| India visa | 51×51mm | 10KB–300KB | JPEG |
| China visa | 33×48mm | under 120KB | JPEG |
| Japan visa | 35×45mm | — | JPEG |
